comparison.objective: Place a cannulated forearm on an elevation wedge without dragging its IV line; the candidate configures a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Supported body-part transfer with flexible-line management and clinical safety, not two-tool torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Forearm must rest correctly on the wedge while the IV remains safe and undragged; candidate grades an adjusted mechanical stop.
comparison.reason: All three versions test constrained patient positioning, not adjustable threaded locking.
